'''Ask Argothil Anything''' was a feature in [[Colonial News Nets]] written by [[Pertaal Shenvehr]]. Shenvehr, an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]], used the regular feature to pass intelligence on to Alliance agents in the field.
